Cauliflower Curry
By: Anonymous
Published: Tuesday, December 15, 2009 - 11:30pm

Ingredients




1 head cauliflower, cut into 1 inch pieces
2 onions, chopped fine
1/2 cup lentils
1/2 teaspoon chili powder
1 teaspoon curry powder
Juice of 1 lemon

Preparation

1 Saute onion in small amount of water 5 minutes. Add cauliflower, lentils, and spices. Add cup of water and cook until cauliflower is tender on low flame. Add lemon juice. Serves 4.
